# DEADHOUSE — Prototype 1: "One Block of Lantern Row"

An urban-noir action RPG set in the invented city of Corvane. You play Ines Calder, night attendant at
the city morgue, who can carry the last hour of the dead.

This repository is an experiment in how much of an original game an AI can design and build on its own.
**Every creative asset is generated by code in this repository.** That covers pixel art, character
animation, portraits, fonts, music, sound effects and writing. No external art, audio or fonts are used,
and nothing is generated by an AI service at runtime.

## Play

**Windows build:** unzip `dist/Deadhouse-Prototype1-win64.zip` and run `Deadhouse/Deadhouse.exe`.
Read `PLAYING.txt` (it's in the zip) for what to try.

**From source (Python 3.12):**

```
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
.venv\Scripts\python tools\build_assets.py      # regenerate all art + audio (≈40 s; needs ffmpeg for .ogg, else .wav)
.venv\Scripts\python -m deadhouse              # play
```

Useful flags: `--area tenement` (start in an area), `--skip-title`, `--fps`, `--fullscreen`,
`--shot out.png --frames 120` (render hidden and save a screenshot).

### Controls (keyboard / Xbox-style pad)

| Action | Keyboard | Pad |
|---|---|---|
| Move / sprint (sprinting is noisy) | WASD or arrows / Shift | Left stick / LT |
| Attack (from behind and unseen: takedown) | J | X |
| Heavy attack | K | Y |
| Dodge (brief invulnerability) | Space | B |
| Interact / talk / climb / pick up | E | A |
| Throw bottle (aims at lamps and bulbs first) | Q | LB |
| Fire revolver (loud) | L | RB |
| Lantern on/off · lantern flash (blinds) | F · C | RS · LS |
| Field dressing (heal) | H | D-pad down |
| Ask your Remnant for a hint | R | D-pad up |
| Inventory, evidence, leads | Tab | View |
| Pause / controls | Esc / F1 | Menu |
| Fullscreen | F11 | |

## Repository map

```
deadhouse/            the game (Python package)
  engine/             window + loop, GPU renderer (moderngl), input, audio mixer, bitmap font
  sim/                game logic only: world, player, enemy AI, perception, combat, dialogue runtime, state
  render/             draws the simulation: scene compositor, sprites, VFX, UI
  states/             title screen, play state
  content/            data: areas (layout + scripting), dialogue (.dlg), items, combat tuning, leads
  assetgen/           every art and audio generator (build-time only)
tools/                build_assets.py, build_exe.py, capture.py (scripted screenshots), audio tools
tests/                pytest suite (simulation, routes, bots, asset integrity, determinism)
assets/generated/     generator output (reproducible; manifest.json holds SHA-256 hashes)
docs/                 design, world, architecture, asset methods, status, roadmap, known issues
deliverables/         screenshots, audio samples and test results for review
```

## Tests

```
.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest tests -q
```
